correctness.rationale: Wheel automorphisms reduce every two-noise-free-leader choice to a hub–rim pair or two rim vertices at cyclic separation d. Grounding hub and rim yields T_(m-1) with diagonal 3 and off-diagonal -1. Grounding two rim vertices yields two tridiagonal path blocks coupled through the remaining hub; its block Schur complement gives J_rr(d)=h_a+h_b+(1+g_a+g_b)/(m-f_a-f_b). Exact small-size values prove m=3 all pairs tie, 4<=m<=6 maximal-separated rim pairs win, m=7,8 hub/rim wins. The Green diagonal recurrence, Cauchy-Schwarz, and a positive radical bound prove all m>=9. Fresh independent SymPy exact rational inversion of EVERY leader pair for m=3..11 confirmed all minimizer types and m=4 31/30, m=7 954/377. This finite run corroborates but does not prove m unbounded.
